description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Use for general questions about what private landlords in England must do, such as gas safety, deposits, EPC ratings, smoke alarms or notices. Searches Lettance's catalogue of rules, each cited to legislation.gov.uk or GOV.UK, and returns matching rule ids with summaries. Use get_rule for one rule's full detail. Read-only.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'gas safety certificate' or 'deposit protection'

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.
